SuperStore

Excel · SQL · Power BI

A retail analysis of sales trends, customer segments, product performance and shipping efficiency from 2015 to 2018.

Educational team graduation projectOriginal report screenshots

Original report image. Tap to enlarge or zoom. Filters in this image are not active on the website.

The question

How did sales change over time, which customers and products contributed most, and how did shipping performance vary?

The approach

The project uses Excel, SQL and Power BI to explore the retail dataset. Separate report pages keep sales performance, customer patterns and shipping operations easy to inspect.
